description: Reads the app's vendors (stalls or shops selling inside the app): "vendors", their "items", a vendor's "sheet" (sold, owed, paid), its "queue" (team, invitations, kitchen), the "payouts" registered and the catalogue's "vocab" { vocab: { withHidden? } } (categories, styles, tags and the requests waiting) and "vocabRequests" { vocab: { status?, vendorId? } }. Changes nothing; neblla_vendors creates and edits.

action.description: What to read. By action: vendors {archived?}; items {kind?, vendorId?}; sheet {vendorId, from?, until?, limit?}; queue {vendorId}; payouts {vendorId?}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

kind.description: items: only items priced in this kind of token.

until.description: sheet: up to this ISO date.

vocab.description: vocab / vocabRequests: { withHidden? } or { status?, vendorId? }.

name: neblla_vendors_read
title: Read vendors
